finding: The native Qwen4Exp MTP class builds its LM head and LogitsProcessor from config.vocab_size and returns those logits directly. The installed checkpoint has 248320 vocabulary rows. No TensorFold-style 79591-ID draft shortlist is present in this model path.
conclusion: The measured Korean vocabulary gain fixes TensorFold-specific draft coverage. It does not imply the same gain can be applied to vLLM, whose MTP head already covers the full vocabulary. A Korean-focused vLLM shortlist would be a different, unmeasured optimization.
